analysis: {'Project A: One-Sentence Summary - A free mobile app that gives drivers instant, state-specific guidance on their rights and responsibilities during traffic stops to keep encounters safer, clearer, and more accountable for everyone.': {'Clarity of Value Proposition': '• Relatively clear – the core value is increased safety and knowledge during traffic stops.
